sn19.21:1.1: Idhāham āvuso Gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ sāmaṇeriṃ vehāsaṃ gacchantiṃ || || 2
sn19.21:1.2: Tassā saṅghāṭi pi ādittā sampajjalitā sajotibhūtā || patto pi āditto sampajjalito sajotibhūto || kāyabandhanaṃ pi ādittaṃ sampajjalitam sajotibhūtaṃ || kāyo pi āditto sampajjalito sajotibhūto || ||
sn19.21:1.5: Acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho ||
sn19.21:2.3: ñāṇabhūtā vata bhikkhave sāvakā viharanti || yatra hi nāma sāvako evarūpaṃ ñassati vā dakkhati vā sakkhiṃ vā karissati || 5
sn19.21:2.4: Pubbe pi me sā bhikkhave sāmaṇerī diṭṭhā ahosi ||
sn19.21:2.6: ahañce taṃ vyākareyyaṃ pare ca me na saddaheyyuṃ ||
sn19.21:2.7: ye me na saddaheyyuṃ tesaṃ tam assa dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya || || 6
sn19.21:2.8: Esā bhikkhave sāmaṇerī Kassapassa sammāsambuddhassa pāvacane pāpasāmanerī ahosi ||
sn19.21:2.9: sā tassa kammassa vipākena bahūni vassāni bahūni vassasatāni bahūni vassasahassāni bahūni vassasatasahassāni niraye pacitvā tasseva kammassa vipākāvasesena evarūpaṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhaṃ paṭisaṃvediyatīti || ||
